config:
[nest]
name = "qos-reo-nest"
chain = "gnosis"
chain_id = 100
rpc_urls = [
    "https://rpc.gnosischain.com",
    "https://rpc.gnosis.gateway.fm",
]
schema_version = 1
block_timestamps = true

# Edge & Node's QoS oracle DataEdge. It emits no events: the publisher calls `submitQoSPayload(bytes)`
# with a JSON `{topic, hash, timestamp}`, where `hash` is the CID of a five-minute aggregate and
# `timestamp` is the bucket's END. The reference subgraph starts at 24,747,400; this nest starts at
# 46,700,000 (2026-06-14 23:15:05 UTC), which covers a 90-day window from 2026-09-13.
[[contracts]]
alias = "data_edge"
address = "0x5b4293b4c0f36cb5d4448950830bc777759b6c4f"
start_block = 46700000
abi = "abis/data-edge.json"

[extract]
top_level_calls = true

# One declaration per topic. Each document is exploded into typed rows when it resolves, so the views
# read columns: computing a day of rollups from the JSON at query time peaked at 3.86 GB. The raw JSON
# is not kept; the CID still names the bytes every row came from. `max_rows` is headroom over the
# largest document seen (2,872 indexer-attempt and 1,234 query-result elements).

# Per indexer, deployment, chain and gateway: the charts and the quality score.
[[ipfs]]
name = "qos_indexer_payload"
on = "data_edge__call_submit_qo_s_payload"
cid_column = "_payload"
cid_json_path = "hash"
json_match = { topic = "gateway_indexer_attempt_qos_5_minutes_prod_v3" }

[ipfs.rows]
table = "qos_indexer_attempt_rows"
max_rows = 16384
keep_content = false
columns = [
    { name = "indexer_wallet", type = "string" },
    { name = "indexer_url", type = "string" },
    { name = "subgraph_deployment_ipfs_hash", type = "string" },
    { name = "chain", type = "string" },
    { name = "gateway_id", type = "string" },
    { name = "start_epoch", type = "u64" },
    { name = "end_epoch", type = "u64" },
    { name = "query_count", type = "number" },
    { name = "num_indexer_200_responses", type = "number" },
    { name = "proportion_indexer_200_responses", type = "number" },
    { name = "avg_indexer_latency_ms", type = "number" },
    { name = "max_indexer_latency_ms", type = "number" },
    { name = "stdev_indexer_latency_ms", type = "number" },
    { name = "avg_indexer_blocks_behind", type = "number" },
    { name = "max_indexer_blocks_behind", type = "number" },
    { name = "avg_query_fee", type = "number" },
    { name = "max_query_fee", type = "number" },
    { name = "total_query_fees", type = "number" },
]

# Per deployment, chain and gateway from the gateway's side.
[[ipfs]]
name = "qos_query_payload"
on = "data_edge__call_submit_qo_s_payload"
cid_column = "_payload"
cid_json_path = "hash"
json_match = { topic = "gateway_query_result_qos_5_minutes_prod_v3" }

[ipfs.rows]
table = "qos_query_result_rows"
max_rows = 8192
keep_content = false
columns = [
    { name = "subgraph_deployment_ipfs_hash", type = "string" },
    { name = "chain", type = "string" },
    { name = "gateway_id", type = "string" },
    { name = "start_epoch", type = "u64" },
    { name = "end_epoch", type = "u64" },
    { name = "query_count", type = "number" },
    { name = "gateway_query_success_rate", type = "number" },
    { name = "user_attributed_error_rate", type = "number" },
    { name = "avg_gateway_latency_ms", type = "number" },
    { name = "max_gateway_latency_ms", type = "number" },
    { name = "stdev_gateway_latency_ms", type = "number" },
    { name = "avg_query_fee", type = "number" },
    { name = "max_query_fee", type = "number" },
    { name = "total_query_fees", type = "number" },
    { name = "most_recent_query_ts", type = "number" },
]
